reason: The tray is needed for the nursery, and this is the only offered action.
expectation: The former will shape the metal into a nursery tray.

effect: The metal became the expected tray, ready to line.
reason: The liner will make the tray suitable for the growing medium; it is the only combination offered.

effect: The lined tray is ready for its growing medium, as expected.
reaction: The assembly is clear but so far routine.
reason: Adding the granules provides a root bed, and is the only offered combination.
expectation: The tray will be filled with clean growing medium.

effect: The root medium is now in the tray; next it needs water.
reaction: The sequence makes sense, though each step has been prescribed.
reason: The wick should draw water to the tray without a pump, and this is the only combination offered.
expectation: A tray fitted with the wick, perhaps still needing a reservoir connection.

effect: The wick is fitted, and the reservoir tap is now available for the connection.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the watering system come together, albeit predictably.
reason: Connect the wick-equipped tray to its nutrient supply; this is the only combination offered.
expectation: The tray will receive nutrient solution through the wick and complete the passive nursery.

effect: The watered tray completes the nursery; planting remains.
reaction: The completed passive setup feels useful, though the result offers little detail on how it works.
reason: Sow the seeds in the prepared tray to start the next crop; it is the only combination offered.
expectation: A planted nursery tray and completion of the crop goal.

effect: The seeds complete the nursery, and the rising dark line makes the wick's passive action visible.
reaction: That small image is satisfying and recalls the storm survival work.

mostWorthwhile.text: Planting the nursery and seeing the dark line rise through the felt gave the assembly a concrete, quietly satisfying payoff and connected it to the storm.

leastWorthwhile.text: The tray, liner and granule steps felt routine in succession: each had only one combination and little descriptive feedback.

surprise.text: The visible dark line through the felt clarified the passive watering, although the wick's general purpose was already signaled.

arbitrary.text: None felt purposeless; each part had an understandable role, though the single available action at every step left no meaningful choice.

continue.text: I would continue to learn what happens to the discovery and the return, though this chapter's largely prescribed assembly alone would not draw me onward.
